top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not Registered (26 TAC §HRC42.052(d) - Illegal Operation - Not R)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were 5 unrelated children found in care at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a fire extinguisher in the front room that is not securely mounted.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All outdoor equipment observed have exposed pinch, crush, or shear points, on or underneath it. It was observed nails and bolts out of the wood and plastic parts.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Copy of the most current sanitation inspection report was not available to review at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Active Play Pre K - 90 Minutes of Moderate to Vigorous (26 TAC §746.2206(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity schedule displayed 60 minutes of outside time this was corrected when the director added 15 mintues to morning and afternoon outside time.
